name: mcp-adobe-creative-gateway
description: Local MCP gateway for Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and XD with policy-gated writes.
long_description: One local MCP surface for Adobe creative desktop applications. Photoshop and Illustrator reuse audited upstream MCP integrations. Adobe XD uses a local UXP/WebSocket bridge with explicit Apply pending approval for mutations. High-risk native-script, destructive, and external-AI operations remain policy-gated. Real Adobe desktop control requires the corresponding applications and, for XD, the included development plugin to be installed and opened in Adobe XD.

tools.name: creative_discover
tools.description: Discover Adobe adapters, connection state, capabilities, and risk classes.

tools.name: creative_write
tools.description: Execute reversible or file-write Adobe capabilities with overwrite protection.

tools.name: creative_authorized_write
tools.description: Execute explicitly authorized high-risk Adobe capabilities through gateway policy gates.
